description: Source code for generating and manipulating JFFS2 on-disk structures for MTD flash memory, including functions for creating, parsing, and writing JFFS2 filesystem data.

methods.name: prep_eraseblock
methods.description: Prepares an erase block for writing, erasing if necessary.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the buffer to align with the specified size, erasing and writing blocks as needed.

methods.name: add_dirent
methods.description: Adds a directory entry to the JFFS2 structure.

methods.name: add_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory inode and adds it to the structure.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a file and its data to the JFFS2 structure.
